Questions

Which courses must I take at University of Phoenix?

In this plan, 33 semester credits are taken at Phoenix, including MGTCB 526 Managing in a Changing Environment, ORGCB 535 People and Organizations, LDRCB 535 Leading Change, ECOCB 535 The Digital Economy, ACCCB 543 Managerial Accounting & Legal Aspects of Business and FINCB 571 Corporate Finance and 5 more. Phoenix requires at least 33 semester credits at Phoenix.

Has University of Phoenix confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Phoenix’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Phoenix’s decisions.
